findings.claim: FY2025 前十大客戶占淨銷售 72%；Apple 直接銷售占 29.8%、Qualcomm 11.1%。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers accounted for 72% of our net sales in 2025. Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of our net sales, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 公司風險因子自述：失去大客戶、客戶合併、訂單或價格下降可能對業務、流動性與財務產生重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: The loss of a significant customer, a business combination among our customers, a reduction in orders or decrease in price from a significant customer or disruption in any of our significant commercial arrangements may result in a decline in our sales and profitability and could have a material adverse effect on our business, liquidity, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

note: 本次搜尋未找到 Apple／Qualcomm 信用降級、破產或下修財測的來源；僅一次搜尋，未涵蓋信評機構新聞。
